description.value: Naked Naturals is a nearly 4,000 sq ft independent organic grocery store in the heart of downtown Qualicum Beach, founded in 2006 and committed to sourcing certified organic, fair-trade, and locally produced food. The store carries a full range of departments — produce, deli, meat, dairy, grocery, and vitamins and supplements — and also supports small regional farms across Vancouver Island. A front patio on Fir Street offers a spot to enjoy coffee or a baked good after shopping.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and corroborates the OSM record: address (#101–671 Fir Street), Qualicum Beach phone (250) 594-0277, and the store's identity as a full-service organic grocery. The site confirms departments including produce, grocery, meat, dairy, deli, and supplements, establishing Basic groceries as true. No website or OSM content mentions bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities, so those remain null. A minor internal inconsistency exists: the location page says Qualicum Beach opened April 2011, while the About Us page says April 2009.
concerns: Internal date inconsistency on website: the location page states Qualicum Beach opened April 2011, while the About Us page states April 2009.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established full-service organic grocery store in downtown Qualicum Beach serving touring cyclists with a broad range of whole foods, local produce, and deli items. Clearly active and relevant for the WWC directory.
